purpose: Prospective evaluation of the already-generated Week 9 slate forecasts; no model changes after lock may be graded as this revision.

games_covered: 1pm and later games represented in the simulation CSV
not_covered: CIN at ATL 9:30 AM ET; no simulation rows or exact lines in the frozen board

scoring_rules.actuals: Official gamebook or verified NFLverse weekly outcome; record source URL, retrieval time, and SHA-256.
scoring_rules.availability: Record ACTIVE, INACTIVE, QUESTIONABLE_ACTIVE, or UNKNOWN separately. Do not turn missing/inactive into a healthy zero; inactive rows are availability misses/voids and are reported separately.
scoring_rules.line_match: Only score exact saved thresholds. Changed/unknown lines are UNscorable; do not interpolate a probability from rounded quantiles.
scoring_rules.settlement: Use over/push/under outcome from actual stat and locked line. Score multiclass Brier and log loss from the three frozen probabilities; also report conditional non-push binary scores where push probability is zero or settlement is conditional.
scoring_rules.aggregation: Report per-market and per-model row counts; cluster uncertainty by game, not player-row independence. Report unscorable and inactive coverage separately.
scoring_rules.promotion: A single slate is a pilot only. No calibration or READY promotion from Week 9 alone.

artifacts.as_of: generated before the 08:23 ET line refresh; current-line fit applies only when overlay exact_threshold=true

outcomes_status: NOT_AVAILABLE_AT_LOCK; score after each game is final and actuals are verified
